_readme: Every guide, build update, and news post. The /guides/ hub and each article's related-guides list read this file.
status: draft until the article page exists at guides/{slug}/ and is ready. Flip it to live to publish; drafts never show on the hub or in the sitemap.
hold: a reason the article can't be published yet. Leave it in place until the owner answers it. A wrong answer on permits or credit is worse than no article.
updated is YYYY-MM. Anything about laws or prices gets rechecked every 6 months: bump updated (and dateModified in the article's schema) when you do.
image: one of our own photos, or null for no photo. No stock photos.
Square-bracket text is a placeholder for the owner to fill in.
